what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to accept an approval-not-required plan for 475 Leominster Shirley Road, after reviewing the building commissioner's letter on frontage easements.
The site plan is to be updated to show the new easement on its next iteration.
At the continued warehouse site plan hearing, the board took up peer review comments and sight-line clearing at the Leominster Shirley Road curve.
The board settled on treating the sound wall as a stipulation: a sample or equivalent and the stated weight specification, with final design at the construction drawing phase.
The applicant is to submit another revised plan set around October 1st, to be approved pending the traffic peer review.

why_it_matters: An approval-not-required plan divides land without a full subdivision review, so the vote settles lot frontage and easements for that property without a public hearing on the lots themselves.

The warehouse hearing is still open; noise berms, a sound wall and sight lines at the curve are what a neighbor or a driver on Leominster Shirley Road would feel, and no final vote on the site plan was recorded.
watch_next: A revised plan set for the warehouse, expected around October 1st, to be approved pending the traffic peer review.
The final sound wall design, due at the construction drawing phase.
